assertion.statement: The finite ray-character expansion and arithmetic Frobenius compatibility give the specified centered weight and cancellation O(N log(N)^(-D)) on every interval progression, with W fixed.
assertion.objects: T_C, the ray field K, K intersect Q(zeta_q), mu_C(b), and h_(C,b,W).
assertion.hypotheses: C is conjugation invariant; arithmetic Frobenius is used; W is a fixed multiple of the conductor of K^ab and b is a unit. The separate Hecke and rational prime estimates are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every fixed D>0 and every interval progression contained in[N].
assertion.parameter_range: All progression steps: large steps use cardinality, small steps use the source estimates.
assertion.uniformity: Uniform in progression and unit b for fixed W; no uniformity as W grows.
assertion.constants: Prime-power L1 error O_H(sqrt(X) log(X)^2); progression error O_(H,W,D)(N log(N)^(-D)).
assertion.normalizations: T_C(p)=2 Lambda_Cprime(p); the character formula has factor1/2 and the denominator [K Q(zeta_q):Q].
assertion.exceptional_cases: Nonunit progression classes contain only primes dividing the modulus; these negligible terms are handled separately.
assertion.limit_order: Fix field, W and source error exponent, then let N grow.

assertion.statement: The two local coefficient-recovery arguments invert the specified integer quadratic substitution and bounded-step integer affine change after a bounded nonzero multiplier.
assertion.objects: Integer quadratic P and the real phase polynomial coefficients; integer affine map A+v n.
assertion.hypotheses: X>=1. For quadratic P in Z[t], a2 is nonzero, B0>=2, |a_i|<=B0 X^(1-i/2), and L>=sqrt(X)/B0. The phase has fixed degree at most d. For affine P(t)=A+v t, A,v are integers, v!=0, |A|<=C X, |v|<=E, L>=X/E and E>=2.
assertion.quantifiers: Each phase polynomial and substitution satisfying the respective lemma, with fixed degree.
assertion.parameter_range: Only the stated fixed-degree and bounded-coefficient regimes.
assertion.uniformity: The quadratic bounds depend on fixed d,B0. The affine multiplier depends on d,E, and the norm-comparison factor depends on d,C+E; neither depends on X.
assertion.constants: Quadratic:1<=k<=C_d B0^(C_d) and ||kp||_(C-infinity[X])<=C_d B0^(C_d)||p composed P||_(C-infinity[L]). Affine:1<=k<=C_d E^(C_d) and ||kp||_(C-infinity[X])<=C_d(C+E)^(C_d)||p composed P||_(C-infinity[L]). The constant phase coefficient is omitted from these norms.
assertion.normalizations: Integer multipliers clear the modular coefficient ambiguities before inversion.
assertion.exceptional_cases: An O(X) translation is retained in weighted coefficient bookkeeping; unbounded affine step is excluded.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the substitution bounds and degree before varying X.

assertion.statement: The Gaussian ideal and rational prime estimates transfer through the fixed W-trick and finite ray-character expansion to the same centered weight, giving the stated power minor-arc bound.
assertion.objects: The ideal and rational von Mangoldt functions, prime-only weights, W-tricked progressions and centered ray-prime combination.
assertion.hypotheses: The actual orbit is totally delta-equidistributed with the stated Q-rational geometry and Haar-mean-zero test. W and the character expansion are fixed.
assertion.quantifiers: All interval progressions of step at most Q; the ideal bound allows every0<delta<1, while the centered corollary retains its restricted regime.
assertion.parameter_range: For the centered corollary delta>=N^(-sigma1) and Q<=delta^(-a), with fixed positive exponents.

assertion.statement: The positive Artin-pattern count and sieve error allow choices giving arbitrarily large simultaneous split primes with the required residues, gcd exclusions and exact dyadic valuations.
assertion.objects: Distinct fixed c_j, k>=2, q>=1, odd squarefree M with7 not dividing M, H,Y>0, u,w and the Gaussian generators.
assertion.hypotheses: The separate Artin asymptotic and Gaussian sieve bounds hold for the chosen fixed ray data.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such fixed collection of arithmetic parameters and thresholds H,Y.
assertion.parameter_range: The final output has q dividing w, u/w^2>H and every p_j>Y.
assertion.uniformity: No uniformity in the fixed arithmetic data is asserted.
assertion.constants: Choose the bad-prime cutoff L so the sieve obstruction is smaller than the positive density, then choose tau_j and N_j.
assertion.normalizations: Residues9 mod16,1+3i mod7 and i modM; v2(d_minus)=6, v2(d_plus)=2 and cross-sign gcd4.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Small odd divisors are excluded by ray conditions, larger ones by the sieve; q is absorbed using c_j->q^2 c_j and w=qv.
assertion.limit_order: Choose L first, then fix K_L, then choose tau_j,N_j and finally exceed the prescribed size and ratio thresholds.
